title: A Dollar Story
synopsis: A Dollar Story follows a single dollar bill as it passes from hand to hand, traveling through different eras, cultures, and defining moments in American history. Through its journey, the film explores the interconnected stories of money, violence, and human lives.
awards: Best A.I. Action Film — World AI Film Festival 2026

paragraphs: Few AI films impress me as much as A Dollar Story by Qiu Sheng, winner of Best AI Action Film at World AI Film Festival 2026. Going into watching this short, I loved the simple brilliance of the premise. Watch as one dollar travels from person to person throughout time. It seamlessly journeys through decades, cultures, and pivotal points in time. The film pays homage to the vibes of silent films, The Godfather feeling, cowboys riding off into the sunset, the romance of Bonnie and Clyde. We feel the grit and intensity of Platoon, and heartbreak of Tupac Shakur's death. Just watching this dollar move from scene to scene is like flipping through American history and film history. A Dollar Story is magnificent in how easily it can weave these worlds together with one little object passed between strangers. Not only is the film visually stunning and packed with film culture, Qiu Sheng tells a beautiful story about money, violence, and the humans who are affected by it all.
editorialReview.verdict: A must-watch. One dollar. Different eras. Countless human stories.
